collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A promising invention proves useless: honor what was learned, or forget it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) spent a whole year building a water wheel to lift water up to the hill gardens. It turns beautifully. It lifts almost nothing. (friend) says a year's work should not be forgotten just because it did not work. (subject) wants to burn it. What should they do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) asks (subject) to explain to the gathering what went wrong. (subject) does, reluctantly. A young builder listens, and the next year builds a bucket chain using half of (subject)'s ideas. It works.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The wheel is taken apart and its wood used for a fence. (subject) is glad to see it go. Years later, (subject) catches (subject.him/her)self drawing a new wheel in the sand.
